articles.title: Alcohol allowed at seats for Scotland's World Cup play-off
articles.summary: Spectators will be able to consume alcohol at their seats when Scotland host the Czech Republic in the second leg of their Women's World Cup play-off in Paisley on Tuesday.

articles.title: Northern Ireland will have 'one last swing' at World Cup place
articles.summary: Boss Michael McArdle says Northern Ireland will have "one last swing" at trying to reach a first Women's World Cup as they look to overcome a four-goal play-off deficit in Portugal.

articles.title: Wales wary but eye record run in World Cup bid
articles.summary: Rhian Wilkinson warns favourites Wales not to underestimate Albania in the second leg of their World Cup play-off semi-final.

articles.title: How do Women's World Cup hopes look for home nations?
articles.summary: England, Wales, Northern Ireland, Scotland and the Republic of Ireland are under way in their Women's World Cup play-offs. How are their prospects looking?
